face_height_59e_status.reason: Three readings, none carrying a page reference. Not blocking: face height is not a lookup key and no capacity, span or clearance result depends on it. Blocking the moment face height is used dimensionally - e.g. bay pitch from beam face, or an elevation drawn to scale.

load_basis: Uniformly distributed product load plus dead load, PER PAIR of beams (dead load = weight of beams). Static load only. Value is the lesser of strength in bending and L/180 deflection.
page_ref: Beam Load Capacities Chart, all beam faces, all lengths
source_anomalies: face_height_in 5.92 is transcribed verbatim on all 42 rows of families 59E/59ER; a documentation table for the same beam gives 5.928, and the source chart was read by Elliott Villacorta on 2026-08-31 as 5.93. The rows are NOT altered: the published value stays as printed so the extract remains reconcilable against its source. 5.93 corroborates 5.928 (which rounds to 5.93 at two decimals) over 5.92. face_height_in is carried as descriptive data only and is not part of any lookup key (key = family + series + span), so the discrepancy affects no capacity result. Resolve to a single figure with a page reference before face height is ever used dimensionally.
